title: A reproduced polylogarithmic-entropy affine disperser and full-B2 logarithmic-power loss

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic certificate-free language in family.py and proof.md. Fixed C=2^20 defines k=ceil(log2(N+2))^C; failed exact metadata shapes return zero. All actual input bits are payload. Folded affine condensation and a reproduced basic SU orbit extractor produce short-seed linear images; indexed alternating extraction breaks their correlations; a reproduced monotone polynomial-graph resilient disperser supplies the output bit. Every field choice is uniform and no advice or field-polynomial prefix is supplied. Runtime is one fixed polynomial with an enormous degree.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"kind":"big_o","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1048576"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exist fixed K>0 and N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-K*(log2 N)^(1048576) for every integer actual length N>=N0 in the full pinned B2 model. The proof supplies universal affine dispersal at dimension ceil(log2(N+2))^(1048576) and the full gate kernel4N-8(d+1). All material extractor, conditioning and resilient-output premises are reproduced in the evidence. This same complete guarantee implies the joint finite projection (4,1).","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact roots, capped powers, field extension arithmetic and primitive order, orbit polynomial linearity, folded affine rank, polynomial graph intersections, truncated-cube covariance and Bonferroni identities; actual small-length zero guards only. No nontrivial asymptotic family evaluation or certification of universal claims.
